program.name: Neck Day
program.subject: Neck & traps
program.blurb: Two neck-and-traps days for every other day: gentle neck holds and shrugs, then the upper back.
program.about: Two days of neck and traps for every day of everything else. The first is gentle neck holds, front, back and side, at half effort, with shrugs and upright rows between. The second is the traps and upper back: shrugs, carries, Y raises and reverse snow angels. The third day trains legs and pushing. Neck work is always gentle and never forced. Abs finish every session; Level II makes the holds longer and Level III asks for heavier weights.
program.split: Neck & traps / traps & upper back / lower & push
